citation: Kim M, et al. Effect of Barley on Postprandial Blood Glucose Response and Appetite in Healthy Individuals: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial. Nutrients 2024.
protocol: Fasted; barley dietary fiber product (about 577 kcal per serving, 106 g carbohydrate, 26 g protein) or rice-flour placebo; samples 0, 30, 60, 120, 180 min
population: n=67 healthy Korean adults, fasting glucose below 126 mg/dL
note: Glucose and insulin by minute in one table, n=67, to 180 min. The placebo arm's energy and macronutrients need checking in the methods; the barley arm is a fibre product, not an ordinary mixed meal.
